description: Prologis, Inc. is a self-administered and self-managed REIT and the sole general partner of Prologis, L.P., through which it holds substantially all of its assets, and it operates Prologis, Inc. and Prologis, L.P. as one enterprise. It began operating as a fully integrated real estate company in 1997 and elected to be taxed as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, and it invests in real estate through wholly owned subsidiaries and other entities through which it co-invests with partners and investors, having a significant ownership interest in those co-investment ventures which are either consolidated or unconsolidated based on its level of control. At December 31, 2025 it owned or had investments in, on a wholly owned basis or through co-investment ventures, properties and development projects expected to total approximately 1.3 billion square feet.
